dict.string: Fn Dictate records your voice for on-device transcription and meeting notes.
Fn Dictate uses on-device speech recognition to turn your voice into text.
Fn Dictate pastes transcribed text into the app you are using.
Fn Dictate reads your calendar to name speakers, title meetings, and prepare pre-meeting briefs. Events stay on your Mac.
